name: Semaphore
flavor: Home and distant arms on a post. Danger with the arm level, clear with it raised. Place on track.

name: Water Tower
flavor: Supplies stockpiled water to nearby stations and rails. Steam trains seek it before running dry. Combine with a coaling stage for a complete service stop.

name: Coaling Stage
flavor: Supplies fuel from the stockpile to nearby stations and rails. Low-reserve trains seek a reachable coaling stage; place a water tower nearby for complete steam service.

name: Power Line
flavor: Carries power along the rails. Chain poles within reach of each other and of a Power Plant.

name: House
flavor: Homes for 20 residents. Upgrade to apartments, a high-rise and a skyscraper for 60, 140 and 300 residents. Population stops at available housing; food comes from Windmills.
